answer: Lease each applicant one licensed lantern depot beside a dune trail for 120 days. The depot holds 30 lanterns with quartz panels, each numbered and photographed at dusk. A 150 token deposit and a 90 dollar license tie one depot to one person, a neighbor signs the nightly tally and a ranger checks serials twice. A forged tally forfeits the deposit and bars the keeper 180 days. Faking 10,000 depots freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 900,000 dollars in licenses. Like a lighthouse that only shines when its keeper climbs the stairs, a fake depot stays dark and the ledger flags it by sunrise.
